issues.message: Write a failing test first, then require kelpUnlocked before the 88-coin 6→8 carrier upgrade. Before kelp unlock, purchaseCarrierUpgrade and proximity purchase must not deduct currency or change capacity; the UI must say 解锁海带后开放. After kelp unlock it may purchase normally, and capacity 8 must show 已满级 with no next price.
issues.evidence: src/game/economy.ts tiers have no requires field; src/game/simulation.ts purchaseCarrierUpgrade only checks tier existence and currency; the current gameplay test buys both tiers while kelp is locked.

issues.message: Write a failing real-fixture migration test first, then migrate the actual seaside-v4 save key and shape into save-v4. The legacy key is ai-game-factory:beach_fish_market_v4:save-v3. Read player.capacity, player.inventory, upgrade.purchases, construction, shelves and currency from the V4 structure, preserve legal carried goods, and write the migrated state to the V5 key.

issues.message: Write failing migration tests first, then preserve legacy V4 tide-pool percentage: locked invested 6/12 must become 48/96; unlocked legacy state must become 96/96. Shared carried inventory must map to the smallest legal 4/6/8 tier that preserves up to 8 carried items when possible; only totals above 8 may be deterministically normalized.
